newsitem.title: USA: NY Times to broadcast on PointCast network.
newsitem.headline: NY Times to broadcast on PointCast network.

text.p: PointCast Inc said Tuesday it agreed to launch a new Internet news channel on its network with the New York Times Electronic Media Co.
The companies said the New York Times will begin broadcasting on the PointCast Network in the fall.
The new channel will be made available to PointCast viewers throughout the United States.
"The New York Times's content will draw upon coverage from the newspaper as well as original reporting developed for the electronic medium," the companies said in a statement.
The PointCast Network is a free network that broadcasts news and information directly to a viewer's computer screen.
The New York Times Electronic Media Co produces the newspaper's Internet site, the New York Times on the Web, and the paper's service on America Online Inc.
